sideMenu.srDescription: Driver navigation: earnings, trips, settings, and more.

settings.intro: App preferences. Account and session are under <profile>Profile</profile> in the main menu.

earnings.title: Earnings
earnings.intro: Sum of final price for trips completed this week. The «Driver share» line appears when the API sends payout per trip.
earnings.emptyHint: No completed trips to count yet — totals update when you complete trips with an end date.

trips.title: Trips
trips.notCompletedInSummary: Trip not yet completed in this summary

pricing.body: The amount shown on the request is an estimate; the passenger pays the final price at the end of the trip.

zones.hubIntro: Choose a sub-screen: daily budget, active session, or new request.
zones.dailyCounterIntro: Daily counter (midnight Lisbon). Usage only decreases when you complete the first trip in the target zone after confirming «I've arrived».
zones.extensionPending: More time request sent to partner. When accepted, the deadline above updates automatically.
zones.extensionReasonPlaceholder: E.g.: Accident on A5; need 15 more minutes to arrive.
zones.extensionGranted: Partner granted +{{minutes}} min to entry deadline.
zones.targetZoneLabel: Target zone · v1 catalog (you can also type manually if the catalog fails)
zones.budgetExhaustedBody: You cannot open a new automatic request until reset (midnight Lisbon) or until the partner authorizes an exception. Contact operations / fleet through your usual channel if you need an extra zone today.
zones.requestUnavailable: Request unavailable — check budget or active session in the Zones hub.
zones.stateInZone: In zone — usage counts on 1st completed trip here
zones.arrivedGateHint: «I've arrived» uses your last server position vs the zone center (up to ~{{km}} km). Keep GPS active.
zones.catalogUnavailable: Zone catalog unavailable — use manual ID if needed.

nav.title: Navigation (preference)
nav.intro: When starting the trip we open the destination automatically. Pickup can be manual or auto on accept (option below).
nav.autoPickupHint: On by default: opens your preferred app right after you accept. Turn off to use «Open navigation» during the trip only.

categories.title: Vehicle categories
categories.intro: Syncs with the server and filters requests you see in the list. Keep at least one category active.

docs.title: Documents and licences
docs.intro: Submit documents for your fleet (partner) review. Approval is done in the fleet panel.
docs.expiredWarning: You have expired documents or overdue dates — contact your fleet.
docs.expiringSoon: Some validity dates expire soon (30 days). Confirm with your fleet.
docs.gateBlockLabel: Block availability until all are approved
docs.gateDevHint: DEV only — in production blocking follows document state on the server.
docs.gateProdHint: Required documents are validated on the server before you can go available.
